title: NexusOps

listing.shortDescription: An enterprise agentic AI platform that orchestrates autonomous support, sales, escalation, and operations workflows with governance built in.
listing.fullDescription: NexusOps is an enterprise autonomous multi-agent orchestration and operational governance platform. Aegis routes intent, Vanguard handles technical support, Meridian qualifies sales opportunities, and Apex manages escalation and governance across Web Chat, Email, Slack, and WhatsApp. Claude-powered structured reasoning, Zendesk and HubSpot automation, knowledge retrieval, human approval gates, and self-healing retries keep complex workflows moving without losing control or context.

closing.clientOverview: NexusOps is designed for multi-tier B2B software teams handling high-stakes support, sales, and incident workflows. Support engineers need automated diagnostics, account executives need instant BANT qualification, operations leaders need live execution visibility, and compliance teams need an auditable record of every tool invocation and human approval.
closing.conclusion: NexusOps turns fragmented customer operations into a deterministic, observable execution pipeline. Specialized Claude-powered agents collaborate through a verified DAG, connect to Zendesk, HubSpot, Bedrock knowledge retrieval, and Slack, and pause at explicit HITL gates for low-confidence or high-risk actions. Retry policies and circuit-breaker behavior provide a resilient path when third-party integrations fail.

challenge.summary: Enterprise support and sales engineering teams were losing time to fragmented tools, manual routing, slow escalation, and fragile integrations. Autonomous actions also lacked consistent authorization and audit controls.

points.title: Fragmented tooling and context
points.description: Zendesk, HubSpot, internal runbooks, and Slack held separate pieces of customer context, forcing teams to copy information between systems.

points.title: Slow triage and escalation
points.description: Manual ticket routing delayed technical diagnosis and left high-value sales inquiries unaddressed while critical incidents moved slowly.

points.title: Unenforced governance
points.description: Refunds, production hotfixes, custom SLA terms, and low-confidence decisions needed explicit authorization rather than unguarded automation.

points.title: Integration fragility
points.description: Rate limits, webhook drops, and third-party timeouts could silently break workflows or require manual replay and engineering intervention.

solution.summary: NexusOps introduced a deterministic DAG execution engine where specialized agents collaborate across channels and systems, use enterprise tools intentionally, and escalate to humans when policy requires it.

points.title: Verified agent topology
points.description: Aegis routes intent, Vanguard handles technical support, Meridian manages BANT sales qualification, and Apex enforces escalation and governance.

points.title: Deterministic execution states
points.description: The engine moves work through QUEUED, TRIAGING, EXECUTING, WAITING_FOR_HUMAN, RETRYING, RESOLVED, and FAILED states with visible telemetry.

points.title: Governed tool execution
points.description: Agents call Zendesk, HubSpot, Bedrock knowledge retrieval, and Slack through explicit tools, with high-risk actions paused for operator approval.

points.title: Grounded support automation
points.description: Vector knowledge retrieval supports error diagnosis and runbook execution while bi-directional ticket updates preserve the operational record.

points.title: Resilient integration mesh
points.description: Exponential backoff, circuit-breaker failover, fault injection, audit logs, and HITL queues make failure and approval paths observable and recoverable.

results.label: Specialized agents

results.label: Omnichannel inputs

workflow.title: Inbound signal received
workflow.description: A Web Chat, Email, Slack, or WhatsApp event enters the system with customer context, SLA tier, and routing metadata.

workflow.title: Aegis triages intent
workflow.description: Aegis classifies intent, urgency, sentiment, and entities before dispatching the request to Vanguard, Meridian, or Apex.

workflow.title: Vanguard or Meridian executes
workflow.description: Vanguard retrieves runbooks and diagnoses technical issues, while Meridian evaluates BANT, sizes ARR, and provisions HubSpot deals with Claude-powered structured reasoning.

workflow.title: Tools and integrations act
workflow.description: Zendesk, HubSpot, Bedrock knowledge retrieval, and Slack receive structured actions while the engine records telemetry and retries transient failures.

workflow.title: Apex governs the outcome
workflow.description: Apex evaluates risk and pauses low-confidence, high-value, hotfix, refund, or Sev-1 actions in the HITL queue until an operator approves or rejects them.

objectives: Coordinate Aegis, Vanguard, Meridian, and Apex across enterprise support, sales, and incident workflows

Provide live DAG topology, telemetry traces, SLA visibility, and operational analytics
